## What is ProtoPie?

ProtoPie is a multi-platform rapid high-fidelity prototyping tool that enables developers to create interactive wireframes quickly and intuitively — in short, rich and realistic prototypes that look and feel like the real thing. [...] ProtoPie is the prototyping equivalent of flying to the moon without years of training. Create rapid high-fidelity prototypes for multiple devices complete with rich animations and complex interactions in a few clicks and drags — entirely code-free.

Best of all, unlike Axure, ProtoPie’s free version has no time limit.

### Intuitive and easy [...] ProtoPie is all about smooth connectivity. This is best seen by its remarkable capacity for the deployment of prototypes — from chat platforms to payment apps — across multiple devices. results.content:
### ProtoPie

ProtoPie is a high-fidelity prototyping tool that helps you create interactive prototypes easily for all kinds of digital products, including phones, desktops, tablets, smart watches, and even cars.

Save your prototypes in the Cloud and share them with both internal and external stakeholders, and test your prototypes on the devices they are intended for. The Handoff feature for developer handoff also makes it a great choice for companies and cross-team collaborations. results.title: Dynamic Prototyping with ProtoPie Connect: Features, Use Cases, and More
results.content:
ProtoPie Connect is an advanced extension of ProtoPie Studio that enables designers to create experiences replicating real-world interactions across various devices, displays, hardware components, and APIs.

ProtoPie Connect functions as a powerful communication hub, using Socket.IO technology to bridge various clients, such as:

 ProtoPie prototypes;
 Physical hardware systems like Arduino boards or Logitech G29 steering wheels;
 External services like IFTTT webhooks and public APIs. [...] ProtoPie Studio: Our powerful prototyping application, available on both macOS and Windows, is where you create high-fidelity prototypes.
 ProtoPie Cloud: A web-based platform that enables you to store, share, and hand off ProtoPie prototypes effortlessly.
 ProtoPie Player: A free app that complements ProtoPie Studio, allowing you to view and test prototypes on iOS, iPad, and Android devices.

ProtoPie Connect is an integral part of the ProtoPie ecosystem. [...] ProtoPie Connect is a game-changer for creating interactive, connected prototyping experiences. Whether you're working with multiple screens, integrating custom hardware, or tapping into APIs, ProtoPie Connect opens up a world of possibilities for dynamic prototyping. Dive into this article to discover how to unlock its full potential and enhance your workflow through seamless integrations and advanced features.
